Map();\n\n    function createPassionRecorder(slotId, promptId) {\n      const slot = document.getElementById(slotId);\n      if (!slot) return;\n\n      let activeRec    = null;\n      let activeStream = null;\n\n      const btn      = document.createElement('button');\n      const status   = document.createElement('div');\n      const playback = document.createElement('div');\n\n      btn.type = 'button';\n      btn.className = 'rec-btn';\n      btn.dataset.state = 'idle';\n      btn.textContent = 'Record — Ghi âm';\n\n      status.className = 'rec-status';\n      status.textContent = 'Tap record when ready. / Nhấn ghi âm khi sẵn sàng.';\n\n      playback.className = 'rec-playback';\n      playback.hidden = true;\n\n      btn.addEventListener('click', async () => {\n        if (!window.MediaRecorder) {\n          status.textContent = 'Recording not supported in this browser.';\n          status.style.color = 'var(--rec-red)';\n          return;\n        }\n        const state = btn.dataset.state;\n\n        if (state === 'idle' || state === 'done') {\n          try {\n            const stream = await navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ audio: true });\n            activeStream = stream;\n            const recorder = new MediaRecorder(stream);\n            activeRec = recorder;\n            const chunks = [];\n\n            recorder.ondataavailable = e => chunks.push(e.data);\n            recorder.onstop = () => {\n              const blob = new Blob(chunks, { type: 'audio/webm' });\n              r2Recordings.set(promptId, blob);\n\n              const audio = document.createElement('audio');\n              audio.controls = true;\n              audio.src = URL.createObjectURL(blob);\n              playback.innerHTML = '';\n              playback.appendChild(audio);\n              playback.hidden = false;\n\n              btn.textContent = 'Re-record — Ghi lại';\n              btn.className = 'rec-btn done';\n              btn.dataset.state = 'done';\n              status.textContent = '✓ Recorded. Listen back or re-record. / Đã ghi xong.';\n              status.style.color = 'var(--green)';\n\n              stream.getTracks().forEach(t => t.stop());\n              activeRec = null; activeStream = null;\n            };\n\n            recorder.start();\n            btn.textContent = 'Stop — Dừng lại ⏹';\n            btn.className = 'rec-btn recording';\n            btn.dataset.state = 'recording';\n            status.textContent = '● Recording… nói tự nhiên rồi nhấn Stop.';\n            status.style.color = 'var(--rec-red)';\n\n          } catch (err) {\n            status.textContent = 'Cannot access microphone.
